description: This file, planAddTC.php, is part of the TestLink open-source testing management system. It manages the addition and linking of test cases to test plans, including functions for filtering, reordering, assigning testers, sending notification emails, and managing custom fields and platforms linked to test cases within test plans.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Represents platform data and functionality for linked test cases.

classes.name: tlKeyword
classes.description: Represents keyword data used for filtering test cases.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Manages user data and retrieval functions.

methods.name: testlinkInitPage
methods.description: Initializes the page within the TestLink framework, including database setup.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects the browser to a specified URL.

methods.name: addToTestPlan
methods.description: Links specified test cases to a test plan and optionally assigns testers.

methods.name: getFilteredLinkedVersions
methods.description: Fetches linked test case versions with filtering options.

methods.name: gen_spec_view
methods.description: Generates a view of test cases in the test plan based on specified filters.

methods.name: gen_coverage_view
methods.description: Generates a coverage view for requirements and test cases.

methods.name: setAdditionalGuiData
methods.description: Sets GUI display properties based on current context and data.

methods.name: buildKeywordsFeedbackMsg
methods.description: Builds a feedback message string for selected keywords.

methods.name: buildPlatformsFeedbackMsg
methods.description: Builds a feedback message string for selected platforms.

methods.name: initDrawSaveButtons
methods.description: Initializes the display of save buttons for platform and custom field modifications.

methods.name: init_build_selector
methods.description: Creates HTML options data for selecting a build to assign testers.

methods.name: addToTestPlan
methods.description: Links test cases to a test plan, manages feature assignment, and sends notification emails if specified.

methods.name: buildStatusFeedbackMsg
methods.description: Constructs a status message regarding test case filtering based on status.

methods.name: send_mail_to_testers
methods.description: Sends email notifications to testers about assigned test cases.
